story.title: Sara Ali Khan gets emotional at Golden Temple
story.summary: During her promotional tour for the film Udta Teer, Sara Ali Khan visited the Golden Temple and was visibly emotional while offering prayers. Accompanied by co-star Ayushmann Khurrana, they traveled through Punjab promoting the movie. Sara shared a joyful Dussehra message on social media with a photo of them together. story.title: Isha Koppikar regrets Dil Chahta Hai rejection
story.summary: Isha Koppikar says she regrets turning down Sonali Kulkarni’s role opposite Saif Ali Khan in “Dil Chahta Hai” due to a prior commitment to “Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat.” The actor stresses adapting with age, avoiding creative compromises, and recalls “Ek Vivaah Aisa Bhi” and Sonu Sood fondly.
